chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou execute a plan to sabotage Ritter's shuttle flight. While Ritter, a conceited scientist, prepares to launch his shuttle to reach a 'high-dimensional world,' Gu Suizhou and Shen Feizhi watch from a shielded observation deck. Gu Suizhou uses an ion launcher to destroy the shuttle's control panel at the moment of ignition. Simultaneously, Gu Suizhou orchestrates a media strike, having the Central News Channel broadcast Ritter's crimes live, effectively stripping him of his status and legal protection before he can escape. The chapter ends with Ritter in shock, realizing his plans are unraveling.
